name: task-scheduler
title: Task scheduler
description: Create scheduled/recurring agent tasks when the user asks for anything periodic or timed (daily digest, weekly check, reminders). Unlock with expand_tools tasks, then create_scheduled_task. Read this BEFORE writing any task prompt.
examples: send me an AI news digest every morning at 9
every Monday check disk health and report
turn this workflow into a scheduled task
author: Nimo
